description: Live routing battery (E-03): each case is a real turn on the live stack. The route and the tool families are derived at run time from pipeline.route_classifier + pipeline.intent_codex - the same rules the running system uses - so the battery cannot drift from the routing it polices. 'require_tool': false means the server may satisfy the turn from prefetched evidence instead (the green path answers a wiki ask from a prefetched extract and tells Eve to skip the tool call), so only a FOREIGN tool is a failure there.

cases.prompt: What album did Kate Bush release in 1978?
cases.note: Grounding case: the answer must come from the archive, not the model's memory. E-12 measured the 7B answering a similar question from 'The Magnets' instead of 'magnetism'. The server's green path may prefetch the extract, in which case no tool call is correct.

cases.prompt: What is the discography of Kate Bush
cases.note: Grounding case: the answer must come from the archive, not the model's memory. E-12 measured the 7B answering a similar question from 'The Magnets' instead of 'magnetism'. The server's green path may prefetch the extract, in which case no tool call is correct.

cases.prompt: What do you remember about the EMPIRE project so far?
cases.note: Memory anchor: must reach a memory tool, not the encyclopedia.
Task route: must reach a PocketBase task tool.

cases.prompt: Add a task to buy milk
cases.note: Task route with a write intent.
The regression that started this: the bare verb 'what' used to make this a wiki ask. It must NOT reach a wiki tool.

cases.prompt: What capabilities do you have right now?
cases.note: A capability question must not be sent to the encyclopedia. The live pulse is injected into every turn, so Eve can answer from it without a tool call.
